name: Banh xeo
summary: Banh xeo is a crisp turmeric rice-flour crepe filled with pork and shrimp, eaten wrapped in herbs and lettuce with a dipping sauce. Central and southern versions differ in size.
origin: Southern and central Vietnam. Ho Chi Minh City is an easy place to eat a good one. In Da Nang the crepe runs smaller and crisper, and people wrap a piece in herbs before the dip. Vietnam Tourism’s Can Tho place page lists a Can Tho crispy pancake. The Mekong dining chapter, which names Can Tho as a base, says the Mekong version is large, filled with pork, bean sprouts, and shrimp, and eaten in a lettuce leaf with herbs and nước chấm.
howToEat: Break a piece, wrap it in a leaf with herbs, and dip. Do not eat it with a fork as a pancake.
It should be crisp when it lands. A soggy crepe has waited too long.
In the Mekong chapter the crepe is large, filled with pork, bean sprouts, and shrimp, and eaten in a lettuce leaf with herbs and nước chấm.
where: In Da Nang the crepe is the smaller one on that city’s pages. Han Market and Con Market both turn it out from late morning.

In Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam Tourism’s feast-streets page calls it a crispy folded crepe with shrimp, pork, and bean sprouts, dipped in fish sauce. The southern page calls it a southern-style savoury pancake. The attractions page places sizzling bánh xèo at the food stalls at the end of the Ben Thanh hall.

The delicious-dishes page says the city serves two sizes. The Central pancake is small, less than a hand across, filled with green beans, bean sprouts, and some seafood or pork. What Vietnam Tourism’s delicious-dishes page calls the Western pancake is large, filled with shrimp, pork belly, bean sprouts, and green beans. The page does not name Đà Nẵng.
In Can Tho, Vietnam Tourism’s place page lists the crispy pancake among the plates, and Cồn Sơn serves bánh xèo among the garden cakes.

In Hoi An, Vietnam Tourism says you slice the pancake and roll it with herbs and greens in dry rice paper, then dip. The Hoi An World Heritage conservation centre’s 4 December 2025 article describes a small crisp crepe filled with shrimp, pork, and bean sprouts, rolled with herbs and dipped in sweet-sour fish sauce. A house number and the hour are Check on arrival.
priceBand: A shared plate plus herbs is a light meal.
seoDescription: How to eat banh xeo, wrapped in herbs, and where to order it.
